column10: MEASURED 2026-08-05 15:36 by LOCK THIS AXIS at the console. The controller accepted it: OK LIM J0 MIN=29 MAX=110 CAL=1 (FW 1.0.0 console 1.2.0). Evidence: Downloads/calibration-row-J0.csv. Do not widen this row again without a new measurement. These are ACCEPTED COMMANDED SOFT LIMITS - angles the operator drove to and chose - NOT mechanical extremes.
